transport: Chrome 157 file-manager UI with a Windows BLE bridge and a physical peripheral

upload.method: One run per configuration on the same LCD, at the same folder depth. Elapsed time from confirming the upload to completion. Disconnect during file 33 after a peripheral reply, before the browser receives it. Includes reconnect and resume. Independent verification is separate.

backup.scope: Two fresh ZIP backups of the same unchanged physical folder after Test 2. Compared every file against original bytes and against the other ZIP. Independent ZIP CRC checks passed.

limitations: Measurements cover this synthetic folder on one LCD. The 1081-file owner collection was not timed in these trials.
The physical browser Test 2 predates the final browser cancellation guard and the 3.58.2 build.
DE3.89/App662 is a new signed test firmware. Hardware throughput for App662, Android DFU and browser DFU was not measured.
